body:
so yeah i have been told by multiple staff such as strucken, shadowwolf, walt and alm that the name Jonathon-at the shops was ok since people know me by jonathon. distraction argued that since he didn't know me by Jonathon that i was breaking the rules... even though he doesn't know me at all.... sooo yeah i feel as though i have been targeted by this guy since we have had situations where he told me to kill myself in public chat... so um yeah. he gave me 1 warning which i then explained to him that i was told it was ok and then after a few minutes of him not saying anything he just straight up banned me. sooo um yeh
profbananaslug, dev_revs and ALM can all vouch for this.

title: -distraction- banned me from ts for 7 days

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
Hello AutoTool.

I have consulted with shadowolf and Walt, and they have confirmed that they never gave you the impression that having the name "jonathon- at the shops" was okay.

As seen in the screenshot below, you were asked to change your name to your in-game name, and you did not. This is against the rules, so you were punished. Since this was not the first time you have committed such an offense, you were banned for 1 week.

This appeal is denied.

Evidence:
